Introduction

What Is MSME (Udyam) Registration?

MSME registration, done through the Udyam portal, formally classifies a business as a Micro, Small or Medium Enterprise based on its investment in plant & machinery/equipment and annual turnover. This isn't a business structure by itself — it's a recognition that any Proprietorship, Partnership, LLP or Company can apply for.

Udyam registration unlocks specific benefits under the MSME Development Act, including priority sector lending, collateral-free loan schemes, and protection against delayed payments from buyers.

Classification

Micro, Small & Medium — How Classification Works

  • Classification is based on investment in plant & machinery/equipment and annual turnover
  • Micro, Small and Medium each have their own thresholds under current MSME rules
  • Any Proprietorship, Partnership, LLP, or Company can apply, regardless of sector, subject to eligibility
  • We confirm your exact classification based on your latest financials during consultation

Step-by-Step

Registration Process & Timeline

1. Data Collection

We gather your Aadhaar, PAN, business details, and investment/turnover figures.

2. Udyam Portal Application

The application is filed on the official Udyam Registration portal — a self-declaration based process.

3. Udyam Certificate

Once submitted correctly, the Udyam Registration Certificate is typically generated the same day.

Required Documents

What You'll Need

  • Aadhaar of the proprietor, partner, or authorised signatory
  • PAN of the business entity
  • GSTIN, if registered
  • Bank account details
  • Basic details of investment and turnover
